name: NorthstarAssist-GuardrailInterventions
signal: Any guardrail block or masking on a harness turn

name: NorthstarAssist-PromptAttackBlocks
signal: Prompt-attack filter blocked the user input

name: NorthstarAssist-DeniedTopicBlocks
signal: A denied topic blocked input or output

name: NorthstarAssist-SensitiveInfoActions
signal: A PII entity or the API-key regex was blocked or masked

name: NorthstarAssist-HarnessAnswers
signal: A final answer was delivered (denominator for ratios)

name: NorthstarAssist-HarnessMaskedAnswers
signal: A final answer was delivered with a value masked and nothing blocked; counted into HarnessAnswers

name: NorthstarAssist-HarnessToolCalls
signal: The model asked for the knowledge base Retrieve tool

name: NorthstarAssist-KbRetrievals
signal: The knowledge base embedded a query, i.e. a retrieval ran

name: NorthstarAssist-InputTokens
signal: Input tokens per model call (grows with retrieved chunks and long prompts)

name: NorthstarAssist-UnguardedHarnessCalls
signal: A harness model call of any kind completed with no guardrail assessment (per-request override, threat E-05)
